name: Citizenship by Investment (CBI)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires property valued at least $400,000, confirmed by an SPK-licensed appraisal, with a 3-year resale restriction annotated on the title deed. A single property or multiple title-deed properties can be combined to reach the threshold; for off-plan/notarized pre-sale contracts, the full $400,000 must sit within one notarized contract.
requirements.fix_path: Acquire and register the qualifying property.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a fixed capital investment of at least $500,000, attested by the Ministry of Industry and Technology, held for 3 years.
requirements.fix_path: Secure and commit the required capital.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a bank deposit of at least $500,000, held for 3 years, attested by the Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency (BDDK).
requirements.fix_path: Deposit and hold the required funds.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires government bonds worth at least $500,000, held for 3 years, attested by the Ministry of Treasury and Finance.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase and hold the required government bonds.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires shares in a Capital Markets Board (SPK)-regulated real-estate investment fund or venture-capital investment fund worth at least $500,000, held for 3 years.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase and hold the required fund shares.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires employing at least 50 Turkish citizens, attested by the Ministry of Labour and Social Security — no minimum capital figure attached to this category specifically.
requirements.fix_path: Establish the business and create the required jobs.

evidence_required.document: SPK-licensed appraisal (real estate) or the relevant regulator's attestation for other categories
Foreign-exchange purchase certificate (DAB) confirming funds moved through Turkish banking channels

outcome.duration_length: indefinite — citizenship granted directly, no residence requirement

sources.title: Acquiring Property and Citizenship - Invest in Türkiye

notes: FORMULA VALUES, tier-1 confirmed and unchanged for 2026: real estate at $400,000, all five other categories at $500,000. HIGH-CONFIDENCE STALE-DATA CATCH: the historical $250,000 real-estate figure still circulates on many CBI-marketing consultancy sites, which have a direct financial incentive to understate current thresholds. A SECOND, subtler confusion also confirmed: many sites blur the $400k (real estate specifically) with the $500k (every other category), presenting a single number as if it applied uniformly across all six routes — this file's six-group structure exists specifically to prevent that conflation. GENUINE PROCEDURAL FINDING: for notarized pre-sale (off-plan) property contracts, the full $400,000 must sit within a SINGLE notarized contract (a rule effective 1 January 2023) — splitting across multiple pre-sale contracts to reach the threshold does not work, though completed title-deed properties CAN be combined. Family included: spouse, children under 18, and disabled dependent children of any age — parents are explicitly NOT included, a real scope limitation worth flagging distinctly from routes elsewhere in this dataset with broader family inclusion. Dual citizenship confirmed permitted — no renunciation required. citizenship_after_months is 0 since CBI genuinely requires no residence period at all, one of the fastest routes to citizenship anywhere in this entire multi-country dataset.
